general_comment.#text: Water quality improver is a new type of environmental protection and ecological water quality and bottom conditioning agent carefully developed on the basis of traditional water quality purification agent and modern biological application technology. Among them, a variety of complex biological enzymes, probiotics, vitamins, trace elements, mineral synergists and salts, through biological and chemical methods, the combined action of aquaculture water, significantly improve the poor water quality and bottom quality caused by organisms such as residual baits and feces caused by high temperature and heat. Suitable for aquaculture fish, shrimp, crab, shell, turtle, eel and other seawater and fresh water surface.
水质改良剂是在传统水质净化剂的基础上，结合现代生物应用技术精心研制的一种新型环保生态水质底质调理剂。其中，多种复合生物酶、益生菌、维生素、微量元素、矿物质增效剂和盐类等，通过生物和化学方法的综合作用，显著改善养殖水体因高温高热引起的残饵、粪便等生物造成的不良水质和底质。适用于养殖鱼、虾、蟹、贝、龟、鳗等海水和淡水水面。

general_comment.#text: Fish feed is traditionally based on marine ingredients like fish oil and fish meal. To reduce cost and improve sustainability, there's a trend of replacing marine ingredients with vegetable ones. Manufactured feeds, important for modern commercial aquaculture, provide balanced nutrition for farmed fish. They come in forms like flakes, crisps, pellets, stick-on tablets, and wafers. The main ingredients for carnivorous fish species are fishmeal and fish oil.
鱼饲料传统上以鱼油和鱼粉等海洋配料为基础。为了降低成本和提高可持续性，现在的趋势是用植物成分取代海洋成分。人工饲料对现代商业水产养殖非常重要，可为养殖鱼类提供均衡的营养。它们有片状、脆片状、颗粒状、粘片状和威化片状等形式。肉食性鱼类的主要成分是鱼粉和鱼油。

general_comment.#text: Plastic waste refers to the discarded materials made of plastic that accumulate in the environment. Plastics are a significant part of municipal solid waste, with containers and packaging being the largest contributors. In 2018, over 14.5 million tons of plastic waste were generated from packaging alone. Recycling of plastic waste involves the recovery and transformation of plastic materials to create new products, reducing the need for virgin raw materials and helping to protect the environment from pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. Despite the benefits, recycling rates for plastics are lower compared to materials like aluminum, glass, and paper.
塑料垃圾是指在环境中堆积的塑料废弃材料。塑料是城市固体废物的重要组成部分，其中容器和包装是最大的贡献者。2018 年，仅包装就产生了超过 1450 万吨的塑料垃圾。塑料垃圾的回收利用包括回收和转化塑料材料以制造新产品，从而减少对原始原材料的需求，并有助于保护环境免受污染和温室气体排放。尽管好处多多，但与铝、玻璃和纸张等材料相比，塑料的回收率较低。

general_comment.#text: Fresh bait is the material basis for the development of aquaculture. The main nutrients of the diet are protein, fat, carbohydrate, inorganic salts and vitamins. These nutrients provide thermal energy for the semi-body to maintain the life activities of the earth body itself or to form new substances. The fresh bait family is a necessary substance for fish and shrimp to maintain life. Breeding bait is the material basis of developing aquaculture industry. The main nutrients of fresh bait are protein, fat, carbohydrate, inorganic salt and vitamin. These nutrients provide thermal energy to the semi-body to sustain the organism's own life activities or to form new substances.
鲜活饵料是发展水产养殖业的物质基础。饵料的主要营养成分是蛋白质、脂肪、碳水化合物、无机盐和维生素。这些营养物质为半生物体提供热能，以维持土体本身的生命活动或形成新的物质。鲜活饵料族是鱼虾维持生命的必需物质。养殖饵料是发展水产养殖业的物质基础。鲜活饵料的主要营养成分是蛋白质、脂肪、碳水化合物、无机盐和维生素。这些营养物质为半生物体提供热能，以维持生物体自身的生命活动或形成新的物质。

general_comment.#text: Crustaceans and shellfish are members of the animal phylum Arthropoda. They are covered with hard, horny carapaces which are jointed for movement. Crustaceans include shrimp, lobster, crab, and crayfish, while shellfish include clams, oysters, mussels, and scallops. They play important roles in maintaining healthy ocean systems. They can be divided into two groups: crustaceans and mollusks.
甲壳类和贝类是动物门节肢动物的成员。它们被硬壳覆盖，这些硬壳有关节以便于移动。甲壳类包括虾、龙虾、蟹和小龙虾，而贝类包括蛤、牡蛎、贻贝和扇贝。它们在维持健康的海洋系统中起着重要的作用。它们可以被分为两组：甲壳类和软体动物。

general_comment.#text: 本数据集描述了＜1kV低压交流电的产品流，从电力生产、传输到最终供应给使用电力的用户。该数据集专为用户侧的电力使用而设计，反映了多种电力来源的混合，包括化石燃料、核能和可再生能源等不同发电方式的组合。数据集符合国际生命周期数据系统 (ILCD) 的相关规定，满足方法学、数据质量、命名规范、审核和文档等方面的要求，确保数据的准确性和适用性，特别是针对电力用户的环境影响评估。

This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

general_comment.#text: Sludge is a semi-solid slurry produced from a range of industrial processes, including water treatment, wastewater treatment, and on-site sanitation systems. It can be produced as a settled suspension from conventional drinking water treatment, as sewage sludge from wastewater treatment processes, or as a sedimentary deposit formed by water. Sludge reduces heat efficiency and may cause scale formation in boilers and heat exchangers.
污泥是一系列工业流程（包括水处理、废水处理和现场卫生系统）产生的半固态泥浆。它可以是传统饮用水处理过程中产生的沉淀悬浮物，也可以是废水处理过程中产生的污水污泥，还可以是水形成的沉积物。污泥会降低热效率，并可能导致锅炉和热交换器结垢。

general_comment.#text: Abalone is a delicacy in several countries, known for its large muscular foot. It usually ranges from 10 to 25 cm across and up to 7.5 cm in depth. It's a tasty shellfish with an interesting nutrition profile, including a supply of iodine. However, it is expensive. Technically, it's a gastropod mollusk in the Haliotidae family, a univalve with a protective shell on one side. The other side attaches to any rocky surface, feeding off of algae. Some species, like the white and black abalone, are at risk for extinction.
鲍鱼是多个国家的美食，以其肌肉发达的大脚而闻名。它的直径通常在 10 到 25 厘米之间，最深可达 7.5 厘米。鲍鱼是一种美味的贝类，其营养成分包括碘。不过，它价格昂贵。从技术上讲，它是一种腹足类软体动物，属于 Haliotidae 科，是一种一面有保护壳的单壳类动物。另一面附着在任何岩石表面，以藻类为食。一些物种，如白鲍和黑鲍，正面临灭绝的危险。

They are ubiquitous either as single-use or reusable/durable plastic cups, bottles, bags, foam food containers, Tupperware, plastic tubes, clamshells, cosmetic containers, up to intermediate bulk containers and various types of containers. These containers are very commonly used for food packaging, packaging medicine, oil and lubricants, chemicals, and beverages.
塑料容器是完全或部分由塑料制成的容器。它们无处不在，无论是一次性使用或可重复使用/耐用的塑料杯，瓶子，袋子，泡沫食品容器，塔珀韦尔，塑料管，贝壳，化妆品容器，还是中型散装容器和各种类型的容器。这些容器非常常用于食品包装，药品包装，油和润滑剂，化学品，以及饮料。

general_comment.#text: Superphosphate is the first chemical fertilizer, made in about 1840 from bonemeal and sulfuric acid. Later, it was made from rock phosphate ore by treatment with sulfuric acid. This material is called ordinary superphosphate or single superphosphate and is 0-20-0-11S. It promotes root formation and is useful when plants are beginning to fruit, supplying nutrients to fuel larger fruit production. It is typically seen in late winter or spring.
过磷酸钙是最早的化学肥料，大约在 1840 年由骨粉和硫酸制成。后来，人们用硫酸处理磷矿石制成过磷酸钙。这种材料被称为普通过磷酸钙或单一过磷酸钙，含量为 0-20-0-11S。它能促进根系的形成，在植物开始结果时非常有用，能为果实的增大提供养分。它通常出现在冬末或春季。

general_comment.#text: Process Water refers to water that has been subjected to treatment and is used in an industrial process. This includes its processing level, technical specifications, treatment received, standard compliance, and quality. Additionally, details such as usage information in the production process, the route of acquisition, and educt name are included. It may also indicate whether the water is from a production mix or consumption mix, and specify the point of availability, such as 'to consumer' or 'at plant'.
工艺用水是指经过处理用于工业生产过程中的水。这包括其处理水平、技术规格、接受的处理、标准合规性和质量。此外，使用信息、获得途径和原料名称等细节也包含在内。它还可能指明该水是来自生产混合物还是消费混合物，并指定可用性位置，如'对消费者'或'在工厂'。

general_comment.#text: Laminaria is a type of seaweed kelp native to the north Atlantic and northern Pacific Oceans. It is characterized by long, leathery laminae and relatively large size. It has potential antioxidant and antibacterial properties and can be used as a laxative. It is also used in medicine for weight loss, high blood pressure, and as a hygroscopic cervical dilator and inducer of labor. It contains iodine, an element needed for thyroid hormones, and is a rich source of iron and potassium.
层带是一种海藻，原产于北大西洋和北太平洋。它的特点是叶片长而革质，体型相对较大。它具有潜在的抗氧化和抗菌特性，可用作泻药。它还可用于减肥、治疗高血压，以及作为吸湿性宫颈扩张剂和催产药。它含有甲状腺激素所需的碘元素，是铁和钾的丰富来源。

general_comment.#text: Bamboo wood is a type of construction material made from bamboo. This unique substance has the look of tree wood despite actually being made from a grass. In recent years, the use of bamboo in traditional wood construction projects is increasing in popularity due to its ecologically friendly nature. Bamboo is a natural resource that provides a high strength-to-weight ratio useful for structures. Its strength is generally similar to a strong softwood or hardwood timber. Some bamboo species have displayed remarkable strength under test conditions.
竹木是一种用竹子制成的建筑材料。这种独特的物质虽然实际上是由草制成的，但却具有树木木材的外观。近年来，由于竹子的生态友好性，在传统木质建筑项目中使用竹子越来越受欢迎。竹子是一种天然资源，具有很高的强度-重量比，可用于建筑结构。它的强度一般与坚固的软木或硬木相似。一些竹子品种在测试条件下显示出了非凡的强度。

general_comment.#text: Wastewater is water generated after the use of freshwater, raw water, drinking water or saline water in various applications or processes. It can also refer to other types of water, such as industrial, cooling, leachate, surface runoff, and agricultural wastewater. Wastewater treatment is the removal of impurities from wastewater before it reaches aquifers or natural bodies of water.

Chemical oxygen demand (COD) is the estimate of oxygen required for the portion of organic matter in wastewater that is subjected to oxidation. It refers to the amount of oxygen required for the chemical oxidation of organic and inorganic components present in wastewater with oxidising agents such as potassium permanganate, potassium dichromate, etc. The COD test helps to identify toxic conditions and the appearance of biologically resistant organic substances.
